title: Chapter 3: Importers / Change Data Capture (features/03_importers)
description: Importers as change data capture: detecting new or changed transcripts, handing off to normalization, and retries. Bulk-loading is NOT the model — each importer watches its source and emits normalized records as they appear. The per-agent adapter epics (Claude Code BOTSPY-669e66, Cursor BOTSPY-4661a5, Codex BOTSPY-357602, Grok Bot BOTSPY-5a3bed, Antigravity BOTSPY-55ea2f) are the per-agent translations of this CDC pipeline; each adapter is only the per-agent translation of the Chapter 3 mechanics. Specs first: features/03_importers/ with per-agent subfolders.
